name: もふもふ大好き家族が聖女召喚に巻き込まれる 2 ～時空神様からの気まぐれギフト・スキル『ルーム』で家族と愛犬守ります～
summary: 聖女召喚に巻き込まれ、家族そろって異世界に飛ばされてしまった優衣たち水澤一家。聖女の起こすトラブルに巻き込まれたくないと考えた一家は召喚国を脱出、近隣にある国ユリアレーナを目指すことにした。――無事ユリアレーナにつき、ほっとしたのも束の間、縁あって優衣の従魔となったルージュとビアンカ、その仔たちが稀少性ゆえに狙われてしまう。大事な従魔達を守るため、優衣は弟・晃太とともに冒険者登録をすることに。とはいえ、一般人の自分達に冒険者なんて務まるのかと不安に思っていたら……守る対象であるはずのビアンカとルージュが凶悪な魔物を次々と倒していって――!?

name: 巻き戻り冤罪令嬢ですが、もふもふ幼女の継母になりました
summary: 両親と義妹に虐げられる伯爵家の養女リシェラは、動物と話せる不思議な力を見込まれ王子の婚約者になった。しかし、王子に力を利用されつくし、最後には無実の罪を着せられて処刑される。しかし処刑の瞬間、なぜか一年前の誕生日に時間が巻き戻っていた。二度と騙されず自由に生きると決意したリシェラは伯爵家を飛び出し、ひょんなことから猫の耳と尻尾が生えた少女ミュナと出会う。動物言語しか話せない彼女と意思疎通を図っていたところ、彼女の養父であるという辺境伯令息のセレイブが現れる。義娘と会話ができない彼は、優れた能力を持つリシェラに契約結婚を持ち掛けてきて……

name: 野垂れ死ねと言われ家を追い出されましたが幸せです
summary: 10歳の時に母を亡くした伯爵令嬢のフローラ。突然の別れに悲しむ間も無く、父親が連れてきたのは後妻と義姉のエリザベスだった。その日から虐げられ奴隷のように扱われる日々を過ごすことになってしまう。そして12歳の誕生日を迎えてすぐ、ついに父親から「野垂れ死ね」と言われ、邸から追い出されることに……さらに死亡届まで出されて……あの男の言った通りに野垂れ死ぬなんて嫌! まだ歩ける。諦めない。唯一の頼りであった、会ったこともない母方の叔父・ローレンスの元になんとかたどり着き一命を取り留めたフローラは、とある人物との出会いで真の愛を知る! 捨てられ令嬢の人生大逆転ストーリー、開幕!

name: ウルトラマンワンダフルワールド
婚約者様、どうぞご勝手に。捨てられましたが幸せなので。
summary: ある任務で昏睡状態に陥った魔術師アリスミ。目が覚めると、「もう君はいりません」と最上位の魔術師で最愛の恋人ザインが表情を変えることなく、別れの言葉を告げてきた。彼の隣に立つのは、まさかの親友ロザリー。ショックを受けるアリスミだが、悲劇は重なり、辺境へ強制異動という残酷な仕打ちが待っていた。愛と友情、そして居場所さえ失ってしまった彼女は、新たな地で「絶対に幸せになってみせる!」と誓う。それから二年が経ち、二度と会わないはずだった彼が再び現れた。しかも、彼の隠し子アティカを一週間あずかることになってしまい……? どん底人生からの心温まるハートフルストーリー、いよいよ開幕!

name: 瞬殺された断罪劇の後、殿下、あなたを希望します
summary: かねてから婚約相手である第三王子と折り合いが悪かった伯爵令嬢ローゼリア。ついに婚約破棄を言い渡された時――衝撃が走る。ローゼリアを侮辱する第三王子を、その兄ハロルドが文字通り凄まじい衝撃を伴って殴り飛ばしたのだ! 場は収まったものの、もはや婚約継続は難しい。「愚弟の非礼を償いたい」というハロルドの提案で、ローゼリアはより良い縁談相手の紹介を受けることになる。けれどどの候補も決定打に欠け、なかなか新たな婚約者は決まらない。なによりローゼリアが惹かれているのは、当のハロルド本人で――。スパダリなのに鈍感な武闘派王子と無表情令嬢のもだもだラブコメディ!

name: 離縁された妻ですが、旦那様は本当の力を知らなかったようですね? 魔道具師として自立を目指します!
summary: 結婚式当日に夫の浮気を知った上、何者かの罠により氷漬けにされてしまった悲劇の公爵令嬢サーラ。彼女が救い出されたのは十年後――その間に夫だったはずの王子は早々にサーラを捨て、新たな妃を迎えていた。挙句の果てに、今のサーラには行き場もできることもないのだから愛人同然の立場で王宮に留まれ、などと宣う始末。だが実は、サーラの中には転生した日本人の魂が目覚めていた!「もうかつての気弱な令嬢じゃない、元夫も王宮もこっちから捨ててやる!」と、自分を救った第二王子リアムを協力者に魔道具師となることに決めたサーラ。前世の知識をフル活用した便利魔道具は、次第に街で評判になっていき――!?

name: 離縁された妻ですが、旦那様は本当の力を知らなかったようですね? 魔道具師として自立を目指します!
summary: 結婚式当日に夫の浮気を知った上、何者かの罠により氷漬けにされてしまった悲劇の公爵令嬢サーラ。彼女が救い出されたのは十年後――その間に夫だったはずの王子は早々にサーラを捨て、新たな妃を迎えていた。挙句の果てに、今のサーラには行き場もできることもないのだから愛人同然の立場で王宮に留まれ、などと宣う始末。だが実は、サーラの中には転生した日本人の魂が目覚めていた！「もうかつての気弱な令嬢じゃない、元夫も王宮もこっちから捨ててやる！」と、自分を救った第二王子リアムを協力者に魔道具師となることに決めたサーラ。前世の知識をフル活用した便利魔道具は、次第に街で評判になっていき――!?

name: 離縁された妻ですが、旦那様は本当の力を知らなかったようですね? 2 魔道具師として自立を目指します!
summary: 王宮を飛び出して開いた魔道具店が絶好調のサーラ。そんな彼女のもとに、元夫ルーカス王子の息子ラーシュが突然の弟子入り! あのクズ夫の子とは思えぬ素直で良い子な彼を加えて、ますます賑わうサーラの魔道具店だが、それを面白く思わない他の魔道具師たちがルーカスと結託して喧嘩を売ってくる。ルーカスはサーラを王宮に呼びつけ、懲りずに再プロポーズを試みようというのだ。当然お断り……なのだが、彼の策略によって王都一の魔道具師と勝負することに!? そんな中、第二王子リアムとサーラが急接近して――。かつての悲劇の令嬢が、愛され魔道具師へ華麗に転身! 魔道具サクセス・ストーリー第二幕!

name: 全てを恨んで死んだ悪役令嬢は、巻き戻ったようなので今度は執事を幸せにします
summary:
――この恩は、百万倍で返しますわ!

前世で婚約破棄の末、処刑が確定して絶望していた令嬢エヴェリーナ。
しかしなぜか突然彼女は無罪放免となる。
それは彼女の執事であるサイラスがエヴェリーナの罪を被ったからだった。
身代わりになった彼のため、幸せにならねばと思ったものの、上手く生きられず、
彼女はついに死を選ぶ。
すると不思議なことに時が巻き戻ったのだ。

「今度こそ、あなたを幸せにしてみせる!」

婚約破棄も陰謀もなんのその!
サイラスに恩を返すため、新しい人生で色んな手を尽くすエヴェリーナ。その奇行に戸惑っていた周囲もだんだんと彼女への評価を変えていき――?
思い始めたら一直線な猪突猛進令嬢と、一途で有能な執事の全力ラブエンタメ!

name: 嫌われ者の悪役令嬢の私ですが、殿下の心の声には愛されているみたいです。
summary: 愛する婚約者が他の女と抱き合っていた――そんな場面を目撃し、ショックのあまり倒れた公爵令嬢ロレッテ。だが婚約者である第二王子オルフレットに別れを告げようとしたところ、突如彼の心の声が聞こえてくる。〈僕の可愛いロテ〉〈君が愛しくて仕方ない〉……『氷の王子』の異名を持つクールな彼は信じられないほどロレッテにデレデレだったのだ! 真実を知って爆速でよりを戻した二人だが、オルフレットはある問題を抱えていた。それは彼に言い寄る男爵令嬢姉妹により第一王子が骨抜きにされて王家がまるで機能していないというとんでもない危機。ロレッテは愛するオルフレットのため密かに動き出し――!?

name: 幼馴染みを優先する婚約者にはうんざりだ
summary: 国内有数の商会の娘で、伯爵の血を引く美貌の持ち主ユウナ。家が決めた婚約者ジュードは何かと幼馴染みアリアを優先する。度重なるデートのドタキャン、挙句アリアからマウントまで取られ、ついにユウナは我慢の限界。――よし、こんな男は捨てよう。そう決意して、決別に向けて動き出す。すると、以前からユウナに秘かに想いを寄せていたという謎の美青年が現れ、一途で甘やかな愛を惜しみなく注いでくる。慌てて復縁を迫るジュードだが、もはやユウナの眼中になどない。過去のクズ男を一蹴し、溺愛してくれる彼との幸せな未来を掴み取れるのか……!? 大ヒット『鬼の花嫁』のクレハが贈る、甘く痛快な大逆転劇スタート!

name: 不要なモノを全て切り捨てた節約令嬢は、冷徹宰相に溺愛される NTRもモラハラもいりません
summary: 我が家はいつでも可愛い妹を中心に回っていた。両親はいつも妹を優先し、妹はなぜか私のものばかりを欲しがった。大好きだった人形や誕生日のプレゼント、そして今度は私の婚約者。幼い頃からの婚約者アレン様を妹が寝取り、彼の子を身ごもった。妹は私に婚約者を譲るよう迫り、両親たちも了承した。ただ彼らは知らない。アレン様が自身の領地運営を全て私に任せていたことを。その領地は破綻寸前であることも。そう、彼の資産も性格も、全てにおいて不良債権だったのだ。今更いらないと言われても、モラハラ男なんてお断り! 婚約解消した後は自由自適に暮らすつもりだったのに、なぜか幼馴染の冷徹宰相に婚約を申し込まれて……!?

name: 再飞行
summary: 歌曲激昂奋进富有活力，很适合《星游记》的主人公麦当，体现出他的勇气毅力。麦当的爸爸麦林在OP中的出现，红色的标志披风，伸出的右手（像是邀请麦当到彩虹海），恰到好处。麦当当时的绝望与天空的绚烂希望相互突出，以及最后约定的手势，都强调了麦当与爸爸麦林要到“彩虹海”去的约定。

name: 断罪後の悪役令嬢は、精霊たちと生きていきます!
summary: 無実の罪を着せられ、国外追放された公爵令嬢ルナリア。乙女ゲームの悪役令嬢に転生していると気付いた時には、クズな婚約者の命令で、恐ろしい魔物の森に置き去りにされていた。怯えるルナリアだったが、精霊が現れて助けてくれる。なんと、ルナリアは『精霊王の愛し子』らしく……!? ルナリアが帝国で精霊たちと穏やかな日々を送る一方、彼女を追放したことで精霊王の怒りを買った祖国では、問題が起きていた!? 貴方が捨てたものの大きさを分からせてあげましょう! 精霊王の愛し子だった悪役令嬢ルナリアと、そんな彼女を一途に愛する帝国の皇太子ルイジアス、そして精霊たちによる、大逆転爽快ラブファンタジー!

name: 断罪後の悪役令嬢に転生したので家事に精を出します。 え、野獣に嫁がされたのに魔法が解けるんですか？
summary: 日本人の凄腕ハウスキーパーだったはずが、気がつくとある屋敷の前にいた悪役令嬢セリーヌ。どうやら自分は乙女ゲームの世界に転生していること、断罪されて呪われた野獣公爵に嫁がされること、この屋敷は隠しルートの舞台らしいことを理解した彼女は、前向きに屋敷で暮し始め、邸内の大掃除や炊事に勤しむ。しかし、旦那様となった公爵はなかなか姿を見せずただ彼からのプレゼントだけが届き続けていた。不思議に思っていたセリーヌはある日、ひょんなことから彼を目撃する。そこにいたのは、セリーヌの理想そのもののぬいぐるみのようにもふもふした野獣の姿で……マイペース悪役令嬢と呪われ公爵の恋物語、開幕!?

name: 邪魔者は消えますので、どうぞお幸せに 婚約者は私の死をお望みです
summary: 公爵令嬢リリネリア・ブライシフィックは死んだ。否、殺された。王太子レジナルドの婚約者として蝶よ花よと育てられた彼女は絶望を知り、貴族令嬢としての全てを失った。名をエリザベートと変え市井に下りた彼女は、今日も淡々と息をする。生家から付けられた侍女ガーネリアと共に薬屋を営み、ただ自らの終わりの日を待つ。この人生にはもはや夢も希望もなにもない――はずだった。元婚約者と再会するまでは。エリザベート――リリネリアに執着するレジナルドに対峙する中で、彼女の心の内に新たな感情が芽生える。それは、闇に葬られた真実を炙り出し――? とある令嬢の死から始まる衝撃ファンタジー!

name: 奪われる人生とはお別れします 婚約破棄の後は幸せな日々が待っていました
summary: 魔力が乏しく魔法がうまく使えないシエルは、聖女に心変わりした王太子に婚約を破棄されてしまう。その直後、王家からの彼女の支度金にしか興味がなかった両親はシエルを家から追い出した。そこではじめて、シエルは周囲の人間から時間や努力、そして彼女の人生までもが搾取されていたことに気づく。これからは自分のためだけに生きようと決意したところ、タイミングよく優秀な冒険者であるクラウスに仲間に誘われて――!? シエルは彼に正しい魔法の使い方を教えてもらい強力な魔法を覚えつつ、冒険者として、かつての自分のように理不尽な目にあっている人たちを助けようと立ち上がり……

summary: 社交界では悪女、結婚後は悪妻と呼ばれる公爵夫人のロレッタは、ある日何者かに毒を盛られた。一命はとりとめたが、目覚めると同時に日本人だった前世を思い出し、自分の現状を見つめ直す。夫のアルフレードと本来の婚約者だったエリスの仲を引き裂いて無理やり結婚したはいいものの、アルフレードとの交流は最低限の、愛のない生活。こんな毎日を続ける意味がないと悟って離縁を申し出たのに、アルフレードは受け入れてくれない。納得のいかないロレッタが「一ヶ月以内に犯人を見つけられなければ離縁する」と宣言すると、アルフレードが急に溺愛してきて……? 素直になれない公爵夫妻の愛の攻防戦、開幕!

summary:
Vultures is a single-player, real-time factory simulation where you construct and manage an ambitious manufacturing operation in a volatile and chaotic market that will eventually crush you and your dreams.

A 3D Factory Sim Tycoon about building fast, profiting hard… and going bankrupt anyway.

Vultures is a single-player, real-time factory simulation where you construct and manage one ambitious industrial operation in a volatile, chaotic market. Your objective isn’t to build a permanent empire: it’s to survive as long as possible before everything collapses.

Buy raw materials

Design conveyor systems

Process goods into higher-value products

Sell at the right moment

Reinvest before the market turns on you

Every run is a race between smart expansion and inevitable bankruptcy.

Build the Factory

Construct and optimize a fully 3D production floor using machines, belts, and processing chains. Turn basic materials into increasingly valuable products while managing layout efficiency, throughput, and storage pressure.

Every machine is an investment. Every expansion is a gamble.
Grow too slowly and you fall behind. Grow too fast and you burn out.

Contracts & Reputation

Take on optional contracts for bursts of cash and access to more machinery and goods.

Produce and sell specific products for special clients who have needs outside the regular market. 

Contracts can rescue a struggling factory… or overload it at the worst possible moment.

Chaos Keeps It Alive

No run unfolds the same way.

Sudden market crashes

Price surges

Critical machine breakdowns

Resource shortages

Your factory won’t just grow — it will wrestle with the free market. And sometimes, the free market wins.

Bankruptcy Is the End

There is no endless empire. No permanent domination. Only inevitable bankruptcy.

When it does, your performance is scored based on profit, efficiency, and reputation. Compete on leaderboards. Learn from failure. Start again, a little smarter and a little greedier.

Telecom Tycoon is a single-player business simulation game, where you take on the role of CEO of a telecom company and build up mobile networks (cellular networks). Starting from a small startup, you may expand your services, manage resources, build a thriving telecommunications group and outcompete your AI controlled rivals to become the leading telecom provider in the world.

Starting the game - randomly generated worlds

Each time you are playing, you can start with an existing or a newly generated random world map, based on several adjustable parameters. The world map contains cities, villages, roads and most importantly, a population which are your potential customers.

When starting the game, you can customise your company's name and colour and choose your initial region. Each region might come with its own unique challenges and opportunities.

Build up your network

You will be building base stations (on top of existing buildings or new towers) and connecting them through microwave or landline. Your stations then send out mobile signals and allow your customers to use them to make calls on your network.

Your core network will include e.g. mobile switching centres and home location registers. 

The simulated population will then start signing up to the different operators. The most relevant factors will be network quality and pricing. You will receive money from the subscribers on a regular basis, however, don’t forget you must also pay for the maintenance of the network.

Movement is simple but must be deliberate. Your engine's built in limiter will require you to wait a moment between movements. Learning the timing of this is essential in order to move at a consistent pace.

Cloaking is the base of any cloaked starship's capabilities. Unfortunately, your cloaking technology also interferes with your navigation system. It will be up to you to manually keep track of where you've been.

Torpedos are your primary weapon against the enemy. As long as you are close enough, they will always hit. But don't miss, the blast will quickly give your position away.

Mines are an indirect but equally effective weapon if used wisely. However in order to hide them from the enemy, they are also hidden from you. Remember where they are or risk tearing apart the hull of your ship against your own mines.

Radar is tricky in a fight between cloaked starships. The readings are fuzzy and unclear, but against a foe skilled at hiding, it might provide the only clues you get at the enemy's position.

summary:
《Dwellink》是一款黑暗奇幻风格的生物收集角色扮演游戏，背景设定在一个危机四伏的宇宙。由于伟大链接的出现，通往Kohara九大世界的传送门被打开，凶猛的Dwellers得以穿越并四处散布混乱与毁灭。你将肩负着寻找这场灾难源头的重任，并彻底终结这场浩劫！

Kohara宇宙正面临前所未有的危机。突如其来的伟大链接，如同九颗星辰之间的无形纽带，瞬间划破了次元之墙，使得每个世界中孕育的Dwellers可以自由穿梭往来，引发了一场肆无忌惮的狂澜。不过半年光景，它们便将人类逼至存亡的边缘。世界濒临崩溃，战争、饥荒和狂热主义如野火般肆虐。在这场浩劫的中心，有一个名叫格罗的索哈蒙学派年轻学生，他尚未觉悟自己将成为拯救末世的关键人物。

《Dwellink：War of the Nine》是一款黑暗奇幻风格的生物收集角色扮演游戏。穿梭于九大世界，感受Dwellers猛攻下的震颤与危机。捕捉这些神秘生物，驾驭它们的力量，在策略性回合制战斗中击败敌人。争分夺秒，揭露伟大链接的真相，赶在Kohara的暮光降临前完成使命！

在九大世界的广袤空间中，潜藏着形形色色的神秘生物。它们可能是魔法动物、恶魔残兵，或是失控魔法实验和科技造物所孕育的异种。这些被称为Dwellers的生物拥有巨大的力量，悄然栖息在各个世界之中。现在，这些生物不再遥不可及，它们可以被你寻找、捕获，并最终成为你的盟友。

捕捉并驯服超过一百种独特而强大的生物，让它们顺从于你的意志。从传统的猛禽、恶魔仆从、扭曲的半人马，到高贵的大天使和神圣的众神，只要你足够强大，这些生物都将在你的征途中忠诚地为你效力。

组建并培养一支强大的Dwellers队伍，来拯救九大世界。训练它们在战斗中发挥最大潜力，解锁它们的独特能力，并深入理解不同类型和属性间的相互作用，以掌握它们之间的精妙配合。

探索充满挑战与机遇的奇异世界，随着你与新的Dwellers建立联系，这些世界将不断扩展：穿越坚硬的岩石，飘浮在蔚蓝的天空，激活古老的元素符文，还有更多精彩等着你。在这破碎世界中，寻找并击败强大首领，夺取其力量。

在回合制战斗中与敌人交锋。生存不仅依赖于狡猾和技巧，每个决策都至关重要：环境、队伍类型、成员属性以及它们的阵位。巧妙地伏击敌人，精心选择战场，或在高风险的赌注中挑战命运！

在Kohara上精心规划你的旅程。治疗机会寥寥，Dwellers众多，风险时刻伴随着你。每一场战斗都潜藏着机遇——但同样可能会让你面对未来的挑战时措手不及。自信满满？可以选择启用永久死亡模式，这将使游戏的风险和回报更上一层楼。

从心土之地的葱郁森林和宁静村落，穿过Vinor的荒凉沙漠与古老废墟，直至Skyworld中的圣洁都城以及更遥远的地方，Kohara的九大世界各具其独特魅力。

这些世界不仅在视觉上独具匠心，它们的斗争也同样各有千秋。随着国家的崩溃和Dwellers的肆意横行，伟大链接重塑了力量的平衡，将人类推向辉煌的顶点或是末日的边缘。

在这场灾难的史诗故事中，人类的未来掌握在你的选择中。随着饥荒和战火的无情蔓延，没有英雄或恶棍，只有被逼至绝境的普通人。你将塑造何种形象？

summary:
Team up with a friend and play as either the artful wizard Thing or the stalwart golem Fist to pull off the heist of the century in this couch co-op top-down brawler!

Thing & Fist is an isometric couch co-op brawler where two players battle their way through the city of St. Avalon as they work to pull off the heist of the century. St. Avalon is a shady city that is home to gangsterism and sorcery in equal measure, and players will need to work together if they hope to stand a chance against the nefarious baddies that lurk around every corner.

As Thing, players can zap enemies from a distance using powerful bolts of lightning while keeping the hordes of goons guessing by swiftly dashing around, behind, and even through them! For those that prefer a more direct approach to trouncing foes, playing as Fist will allow players to make short work of opponents with powerful punches and a dash attack that bulldozes anything in their way. When the throngs of opponents seem like too much to handle, players can stun crowds of enemies with a powerful slam as Fist or conjure a convenient bribe as Thing to direct their attention elsewhere. Players can also support their partner in crime with their character's unique shield ability to ensure that Thing & Fist will be able to pull through each chaotic brawl they find themselves in on their quest to become filthy rich!

As they make their way through the two unique levels of the game, players will find themselves going up against numerous different enemies including slime cops, gunslingers, walking cauldrons, and shadow hands; each of which has their own methods of attack that players will need to work together to outmaneuver. Starting in downtown St. Avalon, players will make their way through the city streets, break in and out of the bank, and scurry towards the escape raft with the cash!

Take up spine and quill in defense of your homeland of New Rodentia! Control the fight with a unique physics based combat system that spotlights the spear. Follow the story of Quillary the porcupine and Dandy the spider on their quest, battle robots, bugs, and more in this indie action game.

Key Features

A unique, rewarding combat model that’s fun to learn and satisfying to master

Streamlined, stage-based design that makes replay and speedrunning painless

A difficult but rewarding experience (with accessibility options available)

A family friendly story, appropriate for ages 10+

Gameplay

Spine and Quill is a tactile, high speed, physics based action game like nothing else you’ve played. Skewer your enemies, tear them apart piece by piece, wrestle them into hazards and other threats, find their weak points and strike.

Every strike you land causes your weapon to get stuck in the enemy, leaving you exposed, but giving you opportunities to deal more more damage or reposition them by force. Spine and quill is set apart by this combat model: It's not just dodge and hit, it’s dodge and hit, and whatever you want to do after that hit.

The default experience will test you to your limits, and require thought and creativity in how you approach each enemy and each encounter. 

Story
An army of robots made of scrap metal and discarded appliances march on the kingdom of Rodentia, intent on capturing animals and bringing them to a dreaded land known only as ‘Zoo.’ 

Quillary, the porcupine princess, embarks on a quest to find her long lost mother, a great rodent warrior who could turn the tide. Along the way she meets Dandy, a friendly spider who was waylaid on a journey of discovery from a far off land. Together they’ll battle robots, meet strange characters, and learn what it means to be a porcupine- to sometimes hurt the people you want to hold close.

summary:
Merlin is a 3D Virtual Tabletop that combines the powers of Unreal Engine and Foundry VTT.

Merlin is a basic 3D Virtual Tabletop that uses the Unreal Editor as its creation tool, and Foundry VTT as its game system layer.

Like other 3D Virtual Tabletops, Merlin allows you to:

Create 3D maps, models, mods and asset packs (using the Unreal Editor).

GM turn-based TTRPGs in these maps (using Foundry VTT and its wealth of advanced game systems and GM'ing tools).

Run games for up to 10 players where you can spawn props, characters and spell effects, destroy buildings, and run your own custom scripts and mods created in Unreal OR Foundry.

You can try out our playtest, which showcases these core features working at a very basic level. Developers and ambitious GMs might be interested in it at this stage, but it's a long way from being ready for most users. Throughout at least the rest of 2025, we plan to keep adding content to Merlin until it's in a more complete and useful state.

Unreal Engine Integration

Instead of creating our own easy-to-use map creation tools, Merlin instead offers compatibility with the wide variety of professional tools already used by Unreal developers.

Merlin also has some basic built-in map editing capabilities, and it is also fairly simple to just buy asset store maps and export them straight to Merlin. We plan in future to sell maps, modules and other add-on content separately, and will have a system for 3rd party creators to do the same.

Foundry VTT Compatibility

In order to use the bulk of Merlin's features, you need to own a copy of Foundry VTT. If you do, you can connect Merlin to a running Foundry server (hosted locally or remotely), and use it as a 3D backdrop to your existing Foundry campaigns.

summary:
This game combines real-time and turn-based strategy. Each turn is divided into two phases of variable duration. This concept is especially interesting when playing with multiple players. That's why it's so easy to create and join online lobbies.

The Game

Build and upgrade your base to develop your economy. Once you're ready, you can start attacking the enemy. Try to overcome their defenses and destroy their base. Depending on the game mode you choose, you either have to destroy all of the enemy's towers or their base.

The Timer

The game is split into two phases: the planning phase and the action phase. During the planning phase, players can place, upgrade and configure towers. During the action phase, the towers perform their actions.

The Multiplayer

This game has been tested with up to eight players at a time. In theory, it is possible to play with up to 100 players in the same lobby. The server capacities are very easily scalable based on demand.

The Campaign

The campaign consists of multiple short, puzzle-like levels in which you must defeat your enemies. Your enemies won't build or upgrade towers, but you will need to try to become strong enough to reach their base before they reach yours.

The Level Editor

The level editor allows you to create your own maps. These can be campaign levels or multiplayer maps. You can control the size of the map and which towers and neutral structures, such as gorges and rocks, have been built.

You can also copy your map files and send them to friends.

summary:
类银河战士恶魔城 × 物理驾驶！手动操控火箭的硬核太空冒险。

肝帝专属，通关不亏！ 主线剧情保底15小时爽玩，多周目乐趣不减。想证明自己？竞速排行榜已就位，等你来刷！多档难度可调，菜鸟硬核各取所需，每一档都能玩出新花样。关卡设计更是离谱，小场景能跟你斗智斗勇，大地图直接让你玩到迷路！

玩嘛，就图个随心所欲： 不爱舔图？没问题！直接掏出 “逃课”攻略 / 捷径地图，跳过繁琐探索，一键压缩游戏时长，直奔战斗爽点！怎么玩，你说了算！

《Nimillion - 最后远征》是一款物理驱动的火箭飞船冒险游戏，核心是 “类银河战士恶魔城” 的探索与成长。你将纯手动操控推进器来驾驶飞船，并逐步解锁钩爪、冲刺、零重力、激光炮等关键能力。磨练你的微操，在险恶地形中穿梭，应对环境陷阱、敌人、物理谜题和平台跳跃关卡。

 这游戏的操控手感很复古硬核，专为喜欢 “受苦但公平” 的玩家设计。如果你受够了现代游戏的 “保姆式引导” ，这里就是你的终极试炼场。休闲玩家慎入。这是献给所有在老派硬核游戏中长大，并享受突破极限、战胜挑战那份成就感的玩家——当然，你获得的新能力会是你最强的后盾。

在这个广阔的物理模拟世界里，没有自动驾驶，也没有怜悯。飞行全靠推进器。每一个机动操作都要求精准、练习和专注，将开飞船变成一门 “易学难精”的高风险艺术。

解锁能彻底改变游戏玩法的关键能力。

三种难度可选，从“硬核”到“噩梦”，总有一款适合你。

就算飞船升级了，活下去依然要靠你的操作和策略——你必须穿越致命陷阱、巧解物理谜题，并用风骚走位或凶猛火力战胜敌人。

探索超过20个手关卡，包含3张巨型开放式地图，其中充满平台跳跃挑战，以及会实时影响飞行的动态环境，比如狂风、瀑布、重力场和力场。

用速通挑战全球排行榜，证明你是真正的大神。 

解锁新能力

获得钩爪、速射推进器、零重力、激光炮等关键装备，将你的火箭从基础飞行器，改装成佛挡杀佛的探索利器。

硬核首领战

准备好迎接多阶段、史诗级的BOSS战。吃透物理机制、用好强化升级，这些战斗将考验你的策略、时机和硬实力，活下来就是胜利。

征服险恶地形

在精心设计的高难度地图中精准穿行：对抗能把船吹偏的狂风、扰乱操控的瀑布、诡异的重力场、挡路的茂密植被……你技术够硬吗？

将物理变为武器

学会利用环境取胜：用重力牵引漂移、靠武器后坐力位移、操控力场解谜……谁说物理法则不能为你所用？

完美支持XBOX手柄，配备力反馈，手感扎实。
三个存档位可供使用。 
内置在线排行榜，随时与全球玩家一较高下。
可选开启 FSR 3/4 + 帧生成技术，性能与画质我全都要。

We control a mouse and try to steal cheeses on the ground, earning points as we steal. However, as we earn points, a cat starts chasing us.

The character controlled by the player will attempt to steal cheeses in various locations and earn points as they steal. However, each theft will attract a cat to chase the player. The player’s objective is to steal as many cheeses as possible and earn the highest score possible without being caught by the cat.

Gameplay: The game takes place on a map. The map consists of various areas with different difficulty levels and locations where cheeses are found. The player can choose between characters or create a customizable character.

At the beginning of the game, the player is placed in an area and begins to see the surrounding cheeses. The player directs their character towards the cheeses and attempts to steal them. Each time a cheese is stolen, the player earns a certain number of points.

However, each theft operation attracts the attention of the cat. With each point earned, the cat begins to move towards the player’s location. The player must be careful and avoid contact with the cat.

The game becomes harder over time. As more cheeses are stolen, the cat moves faster, making it harder for the player to escape. Additionally, some cheeses are more valuable and stealing them earns the player more points, but also carries a higher risk of being caught by the cat.

The objective of the game is to achieve the highest score possible within the specified time period and avoid being caught by the cat. At the end of the game, the player’s scores are displayed in a ranking, creating competition among players.

summary:
Pickup 'N' Packup! is a virtual reality puzzle game about putting objects around your house in their proper places. You don't have all day to clean up the place, so do your best to form the most efficient and quickest way to pick up everything and pack it up!

Overview

You've woken up one day and decided to clean up your room. However, it's not just your room that's messy—it's your whole house! Utilize your environment and your reflexes to the fullest in this virtual reality puzzle game all about putting objects in their proper places. You don't have all day to clean up the place, so do your best to form the most efficient and quickest way to pick up everything and pack it up!
Gameplay

The main game mechanics are simple. Just grab the objects that have a highlight on them, and then put them where they belong! Toys go in the toy chest, and books go in the book bin. Can't grab an object that's just out of reach? No worries! This game allows you to teleport to a given area inside the room you're currently in using your VR controller's joysticks. Accidentally dropped an object out of bounds? Just reset the level! You can also check the time left and the bins you filled with the press of a button on your controller too.
Game Modes

Pickup 'N' Packup includes one game mode as of now (Normal Mode), but two more (Time Trial and Zen) will be added soon.

Normal Mode: The default game mode for Pickup 'N' Packup! You have a set amount of time to place every object into their respective bins. If you do that within the time limit, you win. Simple! There isn't a life system, so if you mess up on a level because you ran out of time, don't worry. Just try again!

A retro arcade game bundle where you must manage a restaurant through four mini-games: Ingredient Run, Cooking, Serving, and Stacking Leftovers. Each game offers unique challenges packaged up in a familiar, replayable arcade format.

In this retro-themed arcade game bundle, play as the eponymous Brucie and single-handedly perform all major ends of restaurant management!

The four included games allow you to hone your skills, each with varying demands for focus and time:

- Ingredient Run: An involved, time-limited challenge to find the most ingredients in an obstacle-laden environment riddled with hazards. Strategize a path to pick up point-multiplying powerups and capture evasive ingredients.

name: Delphinium
summary:
这是一款以隐世山村为背景的温馨农场模拟游戏。在这里你将体验耕种、烹饪、垂钓的乐趣，与村民们朝夕相处，建立起触动心底的羁绊，开启一趟找寻自我与归属感的旅途。

深山之中，坐落着一座属于无家可归者的村落。目前的居民只有9人。

但很快，这个数字将变为10人。

海燕从未想过会回到这里。多年前，她为了追随兄长离开了这里。彼时，她的哥哥是那场从战火中重建家园运动中的风云人物。海燕其实并不关心那些宏大的使命，她真正在意的，只有他。

然而，当野心最终反噬，兄长被处决，运动也随之土崩瓦解。海燕曾围绕他建立起的生活，在一夜之间烟消云散。

数月后，她在曾经被称为“家”的山村里醒来。她深陷哀恸，迷失了方向，她不知道在失去了那个她追随了一生的人之后，自己究竟是谁。

蓝花物语是一款以农场生活为主题的叙事驱动游戏。你将耕种作物、在山间溪流垂钓、烹饪料理，并协助重建这座隐秘的弃民村落，这里的每一位居民都背负着各自的过往。

随着海燕与村民们建立联结，他们之间深藏的往事将逐渐浮出水面，开启全新的对话、冲突以及左右故事走向的抉择。

随着时间的推移，海燕必须决定自己想要建立怎样的未来：是扎根于这个环绕在她身边的脆弱社群，还是告别村庄，去寻找那个独立而真实的自我。

summary:
闯荡命运之街，在程序生成的混乱世界用智慧开辟一条生路。这是一款自由探索的沙盒游戏，讲述街头小混混成长为商人、牧师、走私者、炼金术士、间谍，甚至有朝一日成为能与霸主匹敌的领袖的故事。

命运城，这座你梦寐以求的都市！愿你能在此站稳脚跟。在这款宏大的沙盒角色扮演游戏中，你将自由探索《Streets of Fortuna》的广阔世界，通过涌现式的非线性叙事，体验各种突如其来的混沌事件。用你的智慧开辟一条生存之路，或许有朝一日，你能够挑战那位以铁腕统治命运城的霸主。

初抵这座城市时，你饥寒交迫、疲惫不堪、身无分文……你的首要任务是填饱肚子，找到一处安身之所。在这座全世界最富有的城市，守卫们对小偷小摸和露宿街头的流浪汉严加防范。结识销赃者以兜售偷来的货物，结识艺术品收藏家以抬高出售价格。观察富人和仆从的行为模式，策划一场完美的盗窃。尝试用不同的方式和材料来烹制食物、制造装备，收集有价值的物品进行交易，不要拘泥于固定的配方。务必小心，别引起城市霸主和其他既得利益者的不满。

自由无拘的玩法，在密集无缝的生成式城市中沉浸探索

摆脱职业与等级的束缚，海量的技能待你解锁成长

与《矮人要塞》创作者合作打造，专为玩家自发叙事优化

模拟市民与社群构筑的超拟真无限时长体验

专注于惊险逃脱与劫案策划，而非正面硬刚的战斗

细节丰盈的原创世界观与传说，灵感源自公元500年前后的君士坦丁堡 

这终究是属于你的沙盒世界。在这座繁华的城市，重塑人生的无数可能。如何生存，追求怎样的抱负，都完全由你自己决定。这里没有开发者预设的剧本和任务。就像我们热爱的其他大型模拟游戏一样，我们“仅仅”专注于创造这个精密运转的世界，确保它拥有无限的可能——这里的一砖一瓦都经过我们的精心设计，只为让玩家能够在混沌中书写属于自己的传奇。前往这座城市的任意角落，和任意路人攀谈，尾随他们回家，窥视他们的个性与偏好如何塑造他们的人生。

追随直觉的指引，野心的召唤，或是纯粹的恶趣味。无论你是收藏家、探险家、权谋家还是乐子人，命运城都会为你提供一片伸展拳脚的天地。

本作的开发规模远超 Kitfox 以往的所有项目。历经了数载的研发，虽然，我们已经实现了城市的生成系统，能够对上千个NPC的生活进行基本的模拟，并且攻克了无缝地图加载、模块化架构、生成式角色模型等关键技术难题，但是，我们深知，距离这款游戏完全就绪，还有很多工作需要完成。

游戏玩法方面，目前，我们专注于设计支撑颇为有趣的“盗贼”玩法所需的动作系统与沙盒模拟，持续完善着相关的各种功能。之后，我们还会关注工匠、牧师、政治家等其他角色的玩法设计。

我们已经构建了能够定期更新，支持频繁沟通与反馈循环的开发框架。我们计划让每一次更新都能够与游戏已有的特性结合，来提供更加错综复杂、丰富多样的有趣游戏体验。这样的框架为我们提供了后续开发的基础，让我们能够频繁且快速地为游戏的内容和系统添加新的有趣变化。我们从与《矮人要塞》以及《Caves of Qud》的合作中受益良多，我们了解到，如何在注重细节的同时深化游戏系统，通过社区反馈和发现各种独特的问题，尽可能频繁地保持游戏更新。

简而言之，我们期待你们在这款真正开放的游戏世界中自由闯荡，期待你们做出各种有趣的选择。

summary:
Build your own car and go racing.

Create vehicles in real-time using an intuitive node-based approach. Fine tune suspension geometry and drivetrain characteristics to create an unique driving experience. Exhibition of Speed is a racing game designed with modders and content creators in mind, where creating and modifying vehicles do not require messing around with extensive, complex and undocumented configuration files.

The foundation of the multi-body vehicle simulation engine is designed from the ground up to support all kinds of wheeled vehicles and drivetrain configurations. The flexibility of the simulation is explored through nodes, which are the building blocks of every vehicle. Nodes of different types can be arranged and connected together to form a graph which describes the vehicle you want. As the graph is modified it gets evaluated and the results are reflected immediately on the vehicle being built. The vehicle can be driven while it's being formed and it may be saved and shared with others.

The dynamic physical tire model ensures realistic driving behavior and detailed force feedback on the steering wheel. It is capable of producing effects such as camber thrust and relaxation length, which are usually only present in the most advanced racing simulators.

In the upcoming multiplayer mode, you'll be able to join online races against other players with your custom car and put it to the test. Other players will be able to see your creation but it's up to you to prove it's the best car in the grid!

As the game evolves, more types of suspensions, tires, engines, transmissions and all-wheel-drive systems will become available, enabling a greater variety of wheeled vehicles to be built.

Taxing puzzles meet challenging platforming!

Solve puzzles!

Greta Tanner died in her sleep last night.

The doctors don’t know what to think. Sure, Greta was old, but not old enough to die without an apparent cause. She didn’t take pills, had no medical problems, and had no recent surgeries.

Winter creeps into the small town of Trenton, Alaska. The roads are blocked with snow, and the wind carries an icy dagger.

Dr. Grayson, the town’s new resident doctor, examines Greta's corpse. Some bruising. Slight burn marks on her legs – it could be frostbite. Hidden under Greta’s hair are five crescent-shaped wounds. None are severe enough to have been the cause of death, but the marks are fresh and bloody. There has to be a connection.

Was Greta murdered? Or is there something else going on in Trenton? Some people in town have been acting weird, and a strange song is singing in the wind. Or is that just madness?

Dr. Grayson must find whatever killed Greta Tanner and stop it from killing anyone else.

⚠️ Compatibility Notice

The classic BeachHead games were originally built more than 20 years ago using DirectDraw, a legacy graphics system no longer fully supported by modern Windows versions. To ensure better compatibility, this release includes DDrawCompat, a widely used open-source DirectDraw wrapper.

Although DDrawCompat significantly improves stability and rendering on modern PCs, some systems may still require small adjustments, such as disabling fullscreen optimizations or running in windowed mode.

Amazing Curves Racing: the simple, fast, fun & efficient VR racing simulator, where you start or join a race in seconds. Online multiplayer physics engine hides lag well and the tire model works directly on cubic 3D surfaces, for a high-speed racing experience not available anywhere else.

Amazing Curves Racing (ACR) is a single- and online multi-player* racing simulator featuring advanced physics working directly on bicubic polynomial 3D curved surfaces. The physics engine was designed for network play from the start: lag is well hidden. The tire model provides realistic driving dynamics, including at high speed and on rapidly varying road surfaces, where driving aids can provide an easier or more challenging experience based on driver preferences. The racing line also shows curvature, drawn down INTO the road surface, helping to take curves well the first time and assisting with memorization. Computational Fluid Dynamics are used for realistic airflow modeling, providing for low to very high downforce driving experiences. 3D sound in addition to the HUD map provides helpful feedback for other car locations. 

The cubic 3D surfaces and "energy accurate" / symplectic physics systems were developed in the 2000's. While the graphics are simple for 2026, there's no long waits for levels to load or shaders to compile. The main focus for this Retro-RestoMod racing simulator is fun, engaging physics & gameplay with minimum complexity. ACR's developer created the very first consumer stereoscopic 3D and full VR games (1988: SpaceSpuds for Amiga, 1995: VR Slingshot for PC). ACR's simplified graphics work well on modern VR systems, with excellent stereoscopic 3D depth perception and smooth head-tracking.

summary:
A wholesome, cozy and short 3D platformer about falling, climbing, and learning to fly.

Unihorn is about a young unicorn with a speech difficulty, trying to earn their wings at flying school.

The Flying Academy is built into an ancient mountain, with other students scattered around on various ledges and platforms. Most keep to themselves, working on their own climbs at their own pace.

The platforming is all about careful movement and reading the environment. Each section of the mountain teaches you something new—how to judge distances, when to take your time, how to recover when you slip. You'll find shortcuts nobody mentioned, and sometimes you'll discover other students who took the same detours.

Some unicorns who "failed" years ago still live in hidden spots throughout the academy. They've made peace with staying earthbound, and they'll share tips about tricky jumps or point out handholds you missed.

No timers, no score. Just you working your way up an ancient school that's seen thousands of students, each finding their own path to the sky.

Note: The game is short (around 1 hour of basic gameplay + hidden areas and achievements) - for some people that would be a reason to expect much lower cost, but I do value the game as is because of the hard work I put into it as a solo developer and because of the unique feelings and coziness the game brings.

Cyber Aces: Hope is a story-driven, fast-paced action RPG with social simulation elements. 

Combat System

Take part in the fights full of actions - Fight against a horde of enemies or one on one against a big strong boss! 

Chaining moves to do your combo - Creativity is the key. There is no need to remember complicated patterns.

Multiple playable characters and swap system - Choose your favorites and make more complex combos. Up to two characters can be selected to engage in the battle.

The setting took place in a world known as the Cyber World. Twenty years ago, a big war transpired, planting chaos and despair across the world. The Kingdom of Fenestra was on the brink of losing. However, they were able to turn the tide, and in the end, a peace treaty was signed.

During this war, a boy was found in a ruined village by a high-ranked army commander. The commander brought the boy to one of his acquaintances and left the boy. That boy was later named Ryz Amdee.

After the death of his foster parent, Ryz travels to a remote town in The Kingdom of Fenestra called Millenium Town to meet the man who saved his life. Unbeknownst to him, a secret project had just begun within the area, altering the course of his life forever.

summary:
万达莱利亚（Vandaleria）是一个曾经辉煌现在没落的帝国。自从统治者被推翻后，这片大地饱尝了苦难与艰辛。如今，它迫切需要一位救世主的降临。勇者啊，是时候踏上这场史诗级的角色扮演冒险之旅了。穿越陆地与天空，战斗吧！重燃古老宗教的火焰，夺回你与生俱来的权利。但在此之前，你必须准备好，为这场荣耀之战付出应有的代价。

800年前，万达莱利亚帝国的皇室被推翻，王位落入伪帝之手。九大贵族背弃了帝国，导致其陷入了腐败和冲突之中。经历了数个世纪的痛苦煎熬，它已是曾经的一缕残影。能阻挡黑暗肆虐的，只有真正的原始血脉继承者：那位生活在帝国边陲，一个偏远村庄中刚步入成年的少年。

《Sages of Vandaleria》是一款复古风格的日式角色扮演游戏，灵感来自于该类型的经典作品。它融合了经典的动作冒险机制和角色发展，同时加入了飞艇战斗！在这场史诗般的空中冒险里，你将向九大神祇证明自己的价值，重获他们的青睐，拯救帝国于危难之中——或让它永远堕入黑暗！

万达莱利亚曾是一个庞大的帝国。如今，在伪帝腐败的统治下，这个帝国分裂成了一个充满欺骗和腐败的土地。在旅途中，你将会遇到这片土地的臣民。有些人会挖苦你的追求，有些人则会加入你的阵营——或者为了维护他们理想的世界而战斗。甚至，有些人可能成为你的朋友和忠实的伙伴。你需要他们的帮助来探索世界的九个角落，并重新夺回王位。

如何实现这一点由你来决定。《Sages of Vandaleria》是围绕着经典的日式角色扮演为核心打造的游戏。通过强大的属性系统和各式各样的武器盔甲来塑造即将成为帝国重建者的你——甚至包括那些具有巨大能量的昔日遗物。征服地牢，击败首领，解开谜题来增强你的力量——然后登上飞艇，在空中展开激烈的对决。所有内容均以实时方式展现，灵感源自传奇的SNES Mode 7！

赢得胜利和重夺帝国的道路将会是漫长而充满危机的。或许最大的挑战将来自于你自身：尽管你努力赢得诸神的青睐，但你仍是凡人。你探寻智者，神祇赐予他们祝福，你的力量不断增强。当朋友化为凡人，成为你晋升之路的工具时——你是否能够找到力量以坚守信念，抵制诱惑？抑或是沉溺于对权力的渴望，引发比以往更可怕的时代的到来？

summary:
一场为我们在途中失去的人而设的游戏。 Memento Mori 是一款超现实的步行模拟器，结合了简约的艺术风格和不讲故事的表演，专注于处理损失。

一款为我们在途中失去的人制作的游戏。

体验超现实的线性行走模拟器，探索死亡和亲人去世的悲伤主题。在一片未知的森林中醒来，你发现自己迷失了方向并寻找答案，你会找到你一直在寻找的澄清，还是会发现更多的问题然后找到答案。
处理悲伤和失落

自人类诞生以来，每个人都被迫面对的事情就是失落和悲伤。因此，我们希望制作一款不仅对我们来说很特别的游戏，而且对那些面临同样问题的人来说也很特别。
一场表演 不讲述旅程

沃尔夫韦尔工作室

name: Turmoil
summary:
Turmoil is a 3D isometric top-down action roguelike game. Inspired by a dieselpunk aesthetic, navigate a winding factory space filled with environmental hazards and hostile robot workers with the goal of survival. Rise from the ashes! Show the boss that a worker is more than their mechanical parts.

A 3D isometric top-down dieselpunk-inspired, roguelike game. The world of Turmoil is set in an alternate history where humans developed machines that run on oil to automate society. Eventually, machines began making more machines to boost productivity while safety was disregarded. As the last human left in the esteemed factory of Geargrave Automations, Harry suffers a life-threatening injury to the only thing keeping him a valuable asset to the company. Now, with an injured mechanical arm leaking oil, sitting in the trash, Harry realizes he won't survive unless he fights. He must rise from the ashes, learning how to survive with nothing but his leaking arm and a general knowledge of mechanics. His goal is to avenge the humans who were disposed of in the past by defeating the boss, Kornelius Rayburn Geargrave, and shutting down the factory. Geargrave only values efficiency, output, and profit, so when hearing of Harry's retaliation, all robots are set to go hostile when in the presence of deviant employees. 

Navigate through three different procedurally generated levels of the factory, fighting hostile robots for survival, collecting their oil to continue forward as there is no choice but to persist. Collect blueprints and scrap around the factory to upgrade Harry's mechanical arm. Collect oil canisters to keep him alive and utilize the hazardous environment to defeat attacking robots. Rise from the ashes! Show the boss that a worker is more than their mechanical parts.

name: Corporation Inc.
summary:
Newly hired for a revitalization program, work against a ticking clock and navigate a skeptical boss, a lousy friend, and discrimination while making hiring decisions. Interactive narrative with timed decisions Critical thinking Prosocial Empathy

Corporation Inc. puts the players into the shoes of Maria Villalobos, a 25-year-old Honduran native who comes to the United States to work at Corporation Incorporated as their new hiring manager in their ‘revitalization program’. Maria is put on a one-week trial in which she must review 25 applicants daily while judging their qualifications and skillsets. In addition to working against a ticking clock, she has to exercise critical thinking while navigating a skeptical boss, a lousy friend, and the discrimination most immigrants face upon their arrival to America. It’s up to the player how they navigate their first week at Corporation Incorporated.

name: Eclipse
summary:
Spell-based souls-like combat, with an interconnected world.

Eclipse is a 2D spell-based RPG that falls into the vein of a souls-like. 

Journey through a grim, infected, and interconnected world with plenty of secret paths that may derail your original goals.

There is a wide array of spells to use for offense, defense, and support that will help you tear through any challenges your faced with in a fast-paced environment.

NPCs will task you with making a choice that can change the course of your game, from altering further dialogue to replacing game zones.

Difficulty - Eclipse starts off relatively easy, but quickly ramps up to match with other games in the souls-like genre. Certain resources you can find through exploration will help to lower the difficulty a bit, or make it more challenging for those who desire it.

Game Mechanics:

Spells are your primary way to both navigate the world, and deal with any difficult problems that come your way.

Basic Spells don't deal much damage, but they are fast to cast while costing minimal stamina.

Offensive Spells deal a large chunk of damage for a much slower cast time and larger cost to cast.

Support Spells are expensive in cost and windup time, but they can support you with things like healing, speed, and damage increases.

Consumable Spells are the same as normal spells, but they don't cost any stamina and have an increased effectiveness. The drawback for consumables is that after you use it, it is gone from your playthrough forever.

Rings are a system similar to the ones found in other Souls-Like games, but instead of being a supplement to your stats, they are the sole way to change them around. Because of this, rings have a heavy effect on different stats like health, stamina, damage, and movement speed.

Souls are dropped by the most powerful bosses in Eclipse, gifting you with a new ability such as Double Jump, Wall Jump, and Vision as well as others.

Accessibility Features:

Custom Keyboard Controls

Control

name: Slasher
summary:
Slasher is a Retro third person multiplayer thriller game where you play as either a civilian or the Slasher. Run, hide and outlast the other players while being hunted by the Slasher. A random player chosen to be the Slasher must hunt down and eliminate the other players before time runs out.

Slasher is a Retro third person multiplayer thriller game where you play as either a civilian or the Slasher. Run, hide and outlast the other players while being hunted by the Slasher. A random player chosen to be the Slasher must hunt down and eliminate the other players before time runs out. Unlock new Slasher skins after winning matches to customize your killer. Choose from four different maps to play in, The Suburbs, The Offices, The School and The Camp. 

A five minute timer starts off the round, the slasher must find and take out all other players before the time is up. The slasher can only take out other players with weapons scattered around the map. The weapons last only once, except for the rare chainsaw. Swimming is also a way to take out other players, swim close and drag them under.

Host a game for anyone to join, or use a password and search key so that only friends can join.

More maps, and game modes are coming in the future.

A single player mode is also included, so that offline play is possible.

name: Runecraft
summary:
An endless labyrinth of runic puzzles.

You are a master runecrafter. You have been tasked with solving a series of puzzles using your runic knowledge to delve deeper and deeper into an ancient labyrinth, and discover what awaits you within. Each puzzle will require you to combine runes in more intricate and expansive ways as their complexity increases. Or you can choose to lose yourself within the labyrinth, playing through an endless sequence of puzzles with configurable difficulties.

Every rune transforms streams of magic in unique ways: Changing the polarity of the magic flowing through your runic structure. Earth runes, air runes, fire, water, and more. Power flows from the heavens, and must always reach the void in the correct polarities. The aether and void runes show you the pattern, and it is up to you to draw the correct combination of runes to match it.

Starting with a blank canvas of only the aether and void runes, watch their colors change and show you the pattern. Then drag out the runes you need to solve the pattern, and draw the lines to connect the runic pattern.

summary:
Capy Castaway is a cozy exploration adventure where a capybara pup and a clever crow solve puzzles, help lost animals, and explore a mysterious island after a devastating flood. Play solo or with a friend in this relaxing narrative adventure about curiosity, friendship, and finding your way home.

《卡皮漂流记》是一款温馨轻松的叙事探索冒险游戏。小水豚和聪明的乌鸦需要协力解谜，帮助动物朋友们回家，并探索一座神秘的岛屿。

单人游玩或双人协作，深入这个关于友谊和家的暖心故事。

背景故事

一场洪水将动物园里的几只小动物卷到了远离家园的地方。名叫卡皮的小水豚被冲到一座神秘小岛的海岸，岛上散落着各种遗落物品。

卡皮在这里认识了科维，一只话很多的聪明乌鸦。他们结伴启程，探索这座奇妙的小岛，在这里结识新的朋友，帮助其他落难的小伙伴，并揭开这座岛屿的平静表象下隐藏的故事真相。

《卡皮漂流记》以多伦多的真实往事和地点为原型，打造出融合温馨怀旧与奇妙童趣的游戏世界。

在交织着探索、善意和少许恶作剧的路途中，卡皮和科维渐渐发现“家”这个字的涵义或许比他们所想的更为广大。

化身最可爱的活力二人组

来认识一下充满好奇心、生性喜欢探索的小水豚卡皮，还有总是说个不停的调皮小乌鸦科维。运用他们的能力共同解谜，探索隐秘地点，帮助漂流岛上迷路的住民。你的选择至关重要，所以你所做的决定将影响故事的走向，并有可能开启不同的结局。

操作角色，解开谜题

卡皮能嗅探、挖掘和推动障碍物，而科维能飞行、取物，还能把卡皮带到新的地方。

玩家能结合他们的长处开辟新的道路，揭示隐藏的故事，以富有创意的方式应对挑战。尽情游玩，与万事万物互动，享受这场冒险中必定会遇见的所有欢笑和愉悦时刻。

适合一到两名玩家游玩的温馨冒险

你可以单人游玩并操控两个角色，也可以在合作模式中与一名友人一起踏上旅程。

《卡皮漂流记》旨在为所有人打造轻松愉悦且友好的游戏体验，无论对象是资深玩家，还是其伴侣、家人，抑或是初次接触冒险游戏的小朋友。当另一名玩家带着新的玩法和探索方式加入你的旅程，一段特殊的情谊（和混乱）便就此开启。

无论是与老友还是新朋相聚，这款由故事驱动的温馨冒险游戏都将引领玩家前往一个既陌生又令人怀念的地方，探索以多伦多往事为灵感打造的世界。

在这款回合制的地牢建造者游戏中，您必须招募部队并使用神器来击退豺狼军队，直到援军到来为止。每一天都会有新的故事展开，揭示新的威胁，但也有惊喜。掷骰子并指挥您的部队保护王国！

老鼠王国遭受了攻击！在《老鼠与骰子》中，您必须保护王国直到援助到达。您招募部队卡，购买神器，使用骰子进行攻击，并抽取改变故事进程的冒险卡。

行动

每天您都有一定数量的行动可执行。 每个行动都会使时钟前进一小时。 在一定的时间后，您需要休息并开始新的一天。

建立您的卡组

新的一天开始时，您可以选择一个新卡片添加到您的卡组中。 它可以是一个部队卡或一个神器。

部队卡

部队卡用于攻击营地中的敌人。 有些是近战的，而其他的是远程的。 每张部队卡都有使用的条件，您必须掷出正确的符号才能攻击。

神器

神器是在战斗中帮助您的特殊卡片。 您可能会获得免费的重投，或者也可能是一天中额外的小时数以执行更多的行动。

骰子

骰子可以被投掷并用来使您的部队卡攻击，也可以被丢弃以购买新的卡片或神器。 如何管理它们由您决定。

冒险

每天您都会抽取一张冒险卡。 有时它们是好的，有时是坏的。 它们可能在某种程度上帮助您，也可能在桌面上带来更多的敌人。

重玩性

每次运行都是独特的。 除了少数例外，大多数卡片都是随机抽取的。 您选择的卡片以及您在开始新的一天时抽取的冒险卡，并不总是相同的。

summary:
《Exit Slum 11》是一款异常观察运行模拟器，气氛诡异。

规则很简单：

如果您观察到异常情况、不合适的东西或以前未见过的东西，请跑回起点。

否则，继续跑。

当你到达11号出口时，你就能摆脱这场噩梦。

Exit Slum 11 是一款简短的“跑步”模拟器，其灵感来自于 Backrooms 和 Liminal Spaces。

但是，我们强烈建议您四处走动并仔细观察，因为在每次演练中都可能会出现一些随机生成的异常情况。

如果你未能发现异常情况，你摆脱这场噩梦的梦想将重置为零。

这就是为什么你必须仔细观察，如果你错过了一个异常，你的进度就会丢失，你将不得不从头开始。

该游戏使用最新版本的虚幻引擎 5，所以期待一些不错的视觉效果。

游戏中偶尔也会有一些跳跃惊吓，尽管这款游戏的目的不是吓唬玩家，而是提供一些神秘和怪异的体验。

游戏的设计考虑到了真实性，因此当你四处奔跑时会出现摇头的情况。

如果您喜欢 W、A、S、D 之外的其他内容，选项菜单可以保存您自己的键绑定。

游戏时间可能会在 10 分钟甚至长达 60 分钟之间变化，具体取决于您的观察技巧。

The core mechanic of Star Mountain is the ability to build your own platforms, using you and your opponents characters to reach the star. By frequently freezing your character, you can be offensive to create your own path to victory, or defensive to block in your opponent.

Online and Local Multiplayer

Friends are across the world? Got no friends? No matter! Star mountain features online multiplayer so you can play with amazing strangers and maybe meet your new best friend! Or, if you're lucky and have friends, there is also local multiplayer! (With split keyboard and controller compatibility) 

As featured in Wonderville arcade in New York City!

From March 1st - June 1st 2024, Star Mountain was featured in an arcade cabinet thanks to Mark Kleback and the team at Wonderville NYC!

summary:
A cute, wholesome yuri visual novel about a haughty young girl called Alice who goes on holiday to the Isle of Skye. Once there, she meets the plucky young Piper, and a romance between the two slowly unfolds.

Alice Shah doesn’t want to go on holiday to Scotland, and she most definitely doesn’t want to go to grey, dreary Skye.

Alice has a love for elegant, classy clothes, and she spends hours on her appearance every morning. Alice considers herself a sophisticated, elegant lady, and she has no desire to go tramping through muddy fields to visit crumbling old castles.

Unfortunately for Alice, however, her dad is determined to spend their summer in Skye so he can meet up with a former friend, Ian Carter, and his family: his wife, the haughty Hilda, and their ginger spawn, the loud and boisterous Piper.

Alice hasn’t seen Piper since they were small children, and she has few memories of her. She doubts that she’ll be able to get on with anybody who lives on a teeny-tiny island full of sheep, but Alice is pleasantly surprised.

Piper isn’t as abrasive as her father, or as stuck-up as her mother. Piper is cheerful and laid-back, and she takes a liking to Alice almost at once.

A friendship begins to blossom between the two girls – but what will happen when Alice’s holiday ends and she has to go back to London?

name: I commissioned some bunnies 7
summary:
我委托艺术家们在他们的作品中隐藏兔子和胡萝卜。你有无限的提示，试着找到所有的提示吧！友情提醒：放松。

You may also like

关于游戏
A hidden object game where you must find all the bunnies and carrots to complete each level.
Key features:
?️ 15 Unique artworks
❓ 1500+ Hidden objects total
? 750+ Bunnies
? 750+ Carrots
? ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck
♻️ Restore a small number of bunnies / carrots to a painting so you can find them again! 
? Music for each artwork (optional)
? Achievements
⌨️ Use your keyboard to move / zoom in if you have no scroll wheel
? 3x save slots
?️ Reset progress entirely and play again
? ∞ Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level
Context:
The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bunnies and carrots as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ bunnies and carrots, you will have a lot of searching to do.
Controls:
Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden object, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom.
Difficulty:
All levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you have unlimited, unrestricted hints if you get stuck. Using hints will not ruin your score, or affect your ability to unlock achievements. Play at your own pace!
Get immersed:
Each painting has its own music to help you connect with the world, as you search for all the bunnies and carrots!.
Replayable
You can restore a small number of bunnies and carrots back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few hidden objects left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

Welcome to your endless summer! Escape its influence before the town of Siren's Call erases you completely. This version of the game is a free prologue and covers the first part of this story.

Inspired by games like Persona 4, Higurashi, and Doki Doki Literature Club, Siren’s Call: Escape Velocity is a tropical cocktail of delicious summertime dread. 

As a story that begins at the end, all that's standing between you and adulthood are your old party members. Your best friends.

After a summer of deadly fights with supernatural creatures known only as "Sirens," you and your friends finally have time to relax and enjoy yourselves. But in the wreckage of a job well done...it's become obvious just how fleeting their time with you actually is. Even so, it's your job to say goodbye to each of them and go to college. It's your job to be an adult.

Still, it's five of them versus one of you. And after years of friendship and an entire summer of fighting side-by-side, these people know exactly what it takes to make you want to stay home...for just a bit longer. 

A game that's designed to make you as unsure of yourself as humanly possible, Siren's Call takes full advantage of every aspect of the visual novel format to deliver a mind-warping storytelling experience. Can you get the "Hell" out of Florida? Will you reach Escape Velocity?

summary:
A minimalist turn-based strategy game where forethought is survival. Your past moves repeat in reverse—use them, or be undone by them.

MINIM is a minimalist turn-based strategy game where every room loops and your past actions return to challenge you.

Think carefully, plan ahead, and adapt on the fly as your own actions become your greatest threat.

Every loop is a chance to push further, but only if you can outmanoeuvre yourself.

Complete Puzzle Rooms

Each room is a bite-sized, grid-based puzzle that requires you to reach the exit; simple in concept, but increasingly complex in execution.

Think tactically. Every move, item, or path you choose will echo forward in time.

Face Off Against Past Actions

The twist: when you return to a room, your previous selfs replay in reverse, mimicking every item used, tile stepped, and path chosen.

What helped you escape before now blocks your way. Can you turn your own decisions into an advantage?

Use Abilities to Bend the Rules

Throughout your run, you’ll discover powerful abilities that will aid you in traversing the world.

Dash across gaps, create new walls where there shouldn’t be, and even create mad explosions of fire around you!

These abilities offer long-term strategy and synergy - perfect for building clever systems and breaking them in creative ways. But be warned; your enemies will copy these abilities against you too.

Navigate Shifting Biomes

Each full loop transforms the game world. Environments, enemies, and mechanics evolve between biomes, offering fresh challenge and strategic twists.

No two runs are the same.

With its looping structure, minimalist presentation, and strategic depth, MINIM delivers satisfying, cerebral gameplay for fans of puzzlers that reward planning and experimentation.

Whether you're chasing the highest loop count or just trying to break your own systems in clever ways, MINIM invites you to master yourself—one step at a time.

Explore, gather, craft, fight, and survive the fantasy world with persistent world simulation as an adventurer party. Every part of the world is persistently calculated, environment interacts and changes over time with season and progress. Play alone or play with your friends in multiplayer!

Explore, gather, craft, fight, and survive the fantasy world with persistent world simulation as an adventurer party. Every part of the world is persistently calculated, environment interacts and changes over time with season and progress. Play alone or play together with your friends upto 8 in multiplayer!

"I guess it's another open-world survival craft RPG, how is it different this time?"

Ever thought of an open-world game where stuff in the background never disappears into thin air, or map chunks don’t freeze with everything in them—NPCs, trees, animals, etc.—until the player walks nearby?

How about an open world where nature and the environment constantly progress with the flow of time into the future, with weather, temperature, and seasons shaping the world as they go, and whatever changes you or the world have made are persistent throughout the entirety of the game world?

For example, the fruits you harvested from a tree would rot and eventually disappear even after you’ve moved away from the area, and the trees would change shape with the seasons and bear fruit again the following year.

Cross The World started as a very ambitious project, an answer to that itch I’ve always felt as a gamer who wanted a game just like that.

How does the game play?

The game world isn't procedurally generated. It is 6006x4026(24,180,156 tiles) sized world including ocean chunks on a ground level (z level 0), including multiple underground z levels, that'd be 100+ million persistent tile world.

Game offers Classic mode with features like permadeath and fog of war and casual mode without them.

It's a party-based Roguelike RPG, you can control up to 4 characters or more in your party.

**The Betweenlands is no longer in active development

It's time for Mori to find her place in the world, but she's stuck on the dark and wet Core, miles below the beautiful Surface. She must use her trusty grappling hook to traverse the Betweenlands, clusters of floating islands hovering between the Core and the Surface. Explore and climb unique skyscapes on your way to discovering Mori's true desires in this passionately-crafted high-precision platformer.

Master the use of this addictive physics-based grappling hook to pull off thrilling maneuvers and reach high speeds. Carefully hone your placement and timing to manipulate your momentum exactly how you need. There are a million ways to solve every problem by adjusting how you use this one simple tool.

In a world where the wealthy use massive mechanical wings for vertical travel, help Mori beat the odds and overcome impossible obstacles with nothing but a grappling hook, constantly risking it all for her dream. Meet diverse characters along the way who encourage or challenge Mori's beliefs, forcing her to question why she wants to reach the Surface at all.

Inspired by my own life experiences, The Betweenlands is a painfully personal tale of determination, self-discovery, and the feeling of blazing your own path in a world of deeply ingrained norms and protocols. Created by a single developer*, all mechanics, design, sound, and art (pixel and full resolution) form a cohesive unit to tell a story impossible for AAA studios.

*Demo music by Benjamin Borthwick, trailer music by Noah Choi

The year is 1998. Our hero, Rob, has left the "music industry" for a career as a coder for a large corporation.

Office Nightmare is the sequel to Record Store Nightmare. You control Rob as you navigate the floors of the office building. IN SILENCE WAITS is a modern take on classic graphical adventures. Solve puzzles and avoid dangers as you explore the desolate wastes of a cruel world in search of a new home. In this world, not all monsters must be feared... and not all friendly faces should be trusted.

A Dream To Follow

Across the desolate wastes of Azra wanders a bard, lost amidst the cracks and crevices of the land. He has traveled long and far, searching for a place to call home. His needs are simple: shelter, good food, good drink, and most importantly, good folks to enjoy his music.

Perhaps somewhere like... the fabled City of Id.

'80s Retro Gameplay

In Silence Waits is a graphical, horror-themed adventure game following up on the dark fantasy setting established in The Aching. Still driven by a combination of arrow keys and parser input, In Silence Waits continues the retro 16 color graphics aesthetic with minimalist sound, using command line-based interactivity. Press the arrow keys move the Bard to where he needs to be and simply type in what you want him to do.

The Story So Far

Having been dropped off before a forgotten landmark in the midst of a sheltered canyon, you'll guide the Bard through dangers untold as he searches for a passage to this rare city of peace. You'll meet several creatures along the way, both friendly and fearsome: some looking for kinship, others for a quick meal. So be wary, traveler! Aid comes in all shapes and sizes, but so does danger.

And remember: the solution to a situation presented might not be in the same scene, so if you get stuck explore the regions you can reach and be sure to "look at" everything you can see. Never shy away from experimentation, and if you need to know if a word is supported by the interpreter, just review the valid verbs listing accessible through the main menu.

Above all else, don't fear the reaper!

Tide's past screw-ups make him a questionable choice for the high-stakes black ops, but he's determined to prove himself to Wraith. He can't help but look up to their badass leader. 

Wraith seems rough around the edges, but he warms up to Tide quickly. When the nature of their missions turn sexual, romantic possibilities open up for the two that neither had considered. 

With increasingly dangerous missions and an unpredictable commander, Wraith and Tide know they must count on each other to survive. 

Will their bond as battle-brothers evolve into something more? 

An on-going visual novel series with new 1 to 2 hour stand-alone game episodes coming out monthly in 2025! Our season premieres will be free, and subsequent episodes paid.

A patience test disguised as a game. No builds No stats No safety net Every mistake is yours. Every win is earned.

Win, and the reward isn’t loot or stats—it’s resilience.

Warning: Dissonant may cause clenching, grinding, and character growth.

No builds 
No stats 
No safety net

Just you, the controls, and the consequences.

Dissonant is a love letter to difficult games—built by someone who grew up enjoying them and wanted a way to translate that joy (and frustration) to family members who don’t get it.

The controls are deliberately simple. The challenge isn’t complexity—it’s keeping your head when the game refuses to meet you halfway.

A distilled dose of patience therapy

Simple mechanics you can play with 1 or 2 buttons.

Fragile progress — one mistake can erase a lot

Controller support

What this game aims to ask

Dissonant asks how you react when you fail and whether you keep trying anyway.

Important Warning

Game about patience is challenging and not for everyone.

summary:
我委托艺术家们在他们的作品中隐藏兔子和胡萝卜。你有无限的提示，试着找到所有的提示吧！友情提醒：放松。

You may also like

关于游戏
A hidden object game where you must find all the bunnies and carrots to complete each level.
Key features:
?️ 15 Unique artworks
❓ 1500+ Hidden objects total
? 750+ Bunnies
? 750+ Carrots
? ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck
♻️ Restore a small number of bunnies / carrots to a painting so you can find them again! 
? Music for each artwork (optional)
? Achievements
⌨️ Use your keyboard to move / zoom in if you have no scroll wheel
? 3x save slots
?️ Reset progress entirely and play again
? ∞ Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level
Context:
The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bunnies and carrots as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ bunnies and carrots, you will have a lot of searching to do.
Controls:
Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden object, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom.
Difficulty:
All levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you have unlimited, unrestricted hints if you get stuck. Using hints will not ruin your score, or affect your ability to unlock achievements. Play at your own pace!
Get immersed:
Each painting has its own music to help you connect with the world, as you search for all the bunnies and carrots!.
Replayable
You can restore a small number of bunnies and carrots back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few hidden objects left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

summary:
A game utilizing the concept of “Situation Puzzles”, One More Question gives a new perspective on familiar quizzes, presents a backdrop and story to immerse yourself in, and give a workshop editor of your own to share your own puzzles with others. Enjoy!

Our new game, The Angel's Devil Tail is now on Steam!

关于游戏

WHAT is a Situation Puzzle? 

Situation Puzzle, also known as Lateral Thinking Puzzle, is a game where the storyteller, referred to as the host, narrates a seemingly illogical story. Players then ask questions to uncover the truth. Typically, the host will simply respond with 'Yes', 'No' or 'Irrelevant'. Players can use these answers to their questions to deduce the direction of the truth and ultimately uncover the entire story.

WHAT is the story about?

Awoken on an island stranded amidst nowhere, you are left with no recollection of neither your past nor your future; just the face of first person you met on the island, and her lingering question: “Have you heard of anything about Situation Puzzle?”

WHAT are waiting for you? 

64 engaging Puzzle Stories, with 2 extra chapters, encompassing a variety of themes such as dark, cozy, humorous, and supernatural Puzzles, topped off with an ironed-out storyline entailing 3 endings to offer a rich taste to your experience.

A small, albeit fully-voiced cast and story, recreating the feeling of traditional Visual Novels.

A workshop section of your own, where you can try puzzles created by others in the community, or let your mind thrive and make your own puzzle using the built-in editor.

A compendium of side events, backgrounds, CGs, collectibles and dialogue diary to ensure fulfillment and clarity after every playthroughs. 

Original Soundtracks composed by the team.

HOW would you enjoy the Puzzles?

The core loop is incredibly simple: Read the Puzzle → Question Key Words → Find out the truth.

Not certain about the truth of the story? Why not ask One More Question!

Unleash your creativity in Steam Workshop

The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many ladybugs and aphids as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 20 art pieces to choose from, and 2000+ hidden objects, you will have a lot of searching to do.

Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden object, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom.
Difficulty:
All levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck.
Get immersed:
Each painting has its own music to help you connect with the world, as you search for everything.
Replayable
You can restore a small number of hidden objects back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few hidden objects left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

summary:
An animated incremental game about cloning livestock. Make as many moon sheep as you can. Research technology, upgrade your operation and become a clone farm billionaire!

Welcome to Finn Dorset's Institute For Livestock Replication
You play as Finn Dorset, a humble clone farmer starting out on a grassy dwarf planet. 
Begin with a single moon sheep, a small paddock and a cloning machine. Expand your enterprise clone-by-clone until you have the greatest wool production business in the sector! 

Purchase upgrades and automate your clone production with your hard earned Moon Money!

Deploy futuristic gadgets to produce large amounts of livestock and develop various transport methods to sell your wool!

Defend your farm from hungry hawks and other hazardous hostiles!

Features
- Animated cartoon graphics
- Totally free game (no paid bonuses, loot boxes or coins. You will never be asked for money)
- Hundreds of upgrades and progression levels
- Fully illustrated hand drawn artwork
- Space goose!
- Dynamic evolving visuals
- Hours of game-play 
- In-game and Steam achievements

What even is this?
Another crackpot hand-drawn cartoon game from the developer of Snowflake's Chance and Metal Voyager. FDIFLR is an incremental game in the spirit of titles such as Universal Paperclips and Cookie Clicker.
The genre is often characterized by minimalist visuals so the idea was to have the units and upgrades illustrated as much as possible.
It is an idle/clicker game so there are short to medium periods of waiting to progress. 

Is there sound?
Due to the game being designed to be played while multitasking or in the background there is no game audio, players are encouraged to listen to a podcast or watch approved educational programming on a second monitor.

Who has made this?
Game and artwork was made by Carl Morgan (CarlMorganArt). Special thanks to Dante Morris for naming the title. 

So this is free?
Yep.

Who is Finn Dorset?
Stop digging.

Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden person, click and they will appear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom.
Difficulty:
A full range of difficulty is included, but all levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck.
Get immersed:
Each painting has its own music and ambiance to help you connect with the world, as you search for everyone.
Replayable
You can restore a small number of invisible people back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few invisible people left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 5 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

summary:
Escape the Floor is a multiplayer (4vs1) horror game where one player takes on the role of the Murant, and the other four players play as Survivors, trying to find lost persone, escape and avoid being caught and killed.

History

By the Party's assignment, the team of Liquidators is tasked with locating and extracting a Missing Person on an abandoned floor. The Liquidators' inventory includes a flashlight and a walkie-talkie. The floor is isolated by a hermetic door, which will be opened after some time from the beginning of the task or upon delivering the Missing Person.

Be vigilant, the floor is not safe: due to the Samosbor, an aggressive creature known as the Ratman inhabits there. The Ratman is blind and perceives the surrounding world like a bat - through echolocation. Its strong paws and sharp claws pose an extreme danger.
Key Features

Five players, two roles - the roles of Liquidators and Ratmen are assigned to the players. Each player brings their own gaming style, strategies, and character, playing not against the computer, but against each other. The use of in-game voice chat complements this experience, allowing players to coordinate actions, build tactics, and discuss events. This maintains a constant dynamic and unexpected turns of events, making each gaming session unpredictable and thrilling.

Liquidator, be silent to avoid detection - the Ratman relies on echolocation to navigate the world. Every sound created by the Liquidators can be a fatal mistake, while for the Ratman, sound becomes the key to survival. Thus, sound in the game is not only an atmospheric element but the main gameplay mechanism that determines players' actions and strategies, creating a tense and captivating gaming experience.

Your life, your choices—now face the Judgement. 

What happens when the story of your life is laid bare? In Judgement, a narrative-driven visual novel, you find yourself in the afterlife, where your every action, decision, and intention is weighed. The choices you made in life echo here, where truth is the only currency—and the consequences are eternal. 

But how can the guardians judge who you truly were without knowing the real you? Their solution: send you back. 

Each guardian will transport you to a fictitious Earth scenario—crafted to test your moral compass. One moment, you’re on a date at a restaurant; the next, you’re making a life-altering decision in a hospital hallway. With each choice, you reveal more of your nature. Upon returning, the guardians evaluate your actions before guiding you to the next trial. 

Will you seek redemption, cling to your regrets, or defy the forces that pass final judgment? The outcome is in your hands. 

Key Features: 

Interactive Storytelling: Your decisions shape the narrative, with multiple paths and endings. 

Moral Dilemmas: Face tough choices that challenge your understanding of right and wrong. 

Fictitious Earth Scenarios: Experience immersive, lifelike situations designed to test your character. 

Haunting Atmosphere: Explore a mysterious afterlife where every moment feels like a revelation. 

Compelling Characters: Encounter enigmatic guardians who will test your resolve, and reveal truths you might wish stayed buried. 

Life is over. But your story isn’t. The Judgement awaits.

Design Philosophy

FRM offers a unique sandbox experience. The game focuses on bringing the management aspect of the motorsport world to life by providing a challenging simulation, where you steer a racing team in a dynamically changing racing world while respecting your time. Seasons are dynamic, quick, and exciting.
Dynamic

You take on one of ten teams in the most prestigious motorsport competition. Not only do you need to pick suppliers and secure new sponsors each season, but suppliers and sponsors will change over time. Even teams might decide to sell their team to suppliers and sponsors bringing new names into the competition.

Drivers and Staff will be the backbone of your team, but they also develop and hone their skills and will eventually retire. When they retire, you may choose a new name and nationality for the newcomers that will generate or choose to let their names be reincarnated into the talent pool.
Putting the Manager into the Manager Genre

You will not spend most of your time babysitting your drivers on the track. You are paying a race engineer to do that after all. Instead, you will plan the race weekend, and tell them what to focus on and what degree of risk you want them to take for the strategy.

This game is about car development, financial management, picking the right staff, and the right drivers, and planning to get your team to the top of the world.
In-Game Editor
The game has an In-Game Editor to offer all kinds of customization. Change Teams, Drivers, Sponsors, Suppliers and so on. Make the game yours and upload it to the workshop for others to experience!
What this is not!
I don't want to lie to you and I don't want to oversell my game.

Inconvenience Store offers a unique experience combining the management of store resources and strategic thinking aimed at maximizing profits, with real-time action, because as the only employee in this business among the dead, you can only rely on yourself. The underworld awaits if you twiddle your thumbs.
As your days change and the events unfold, you're tasked with responding to customer requests, organizing shelves, replenishing stock and simply keeping the store on its feet in the face of any problems that may arise. Pacts for more money : Make a pact with the demon Yhul-Ghurt, hidden in the store's cold room. In exchange for increased difficulty via in-game events, Yhul-Ghurt offers you a money multiplier at the end of each day. 

A unique world of the dead : Immerse yourself in a world of the dead, far removed from the gray and cobwebs of sad ghosts and creepy skeletons.
Instead, make way for a colorful universe, inhabitants with unique characters and a store more akin to an attraction than a real convenience store.

实验失败后，亚历克斯变成了一个球。当他发现自己身处平行宇宙时，事情变得更加复杂。这是一款基于物理的3D平台游戏，只要你不摔倒、不死亡、不退出，就可以一口气通关。

这是一款物理驱动的游戏。每一次滚动、跳跃和冲刺都取决于你的精准操作。这不只是从起点到终点的移动，更是关于掌握惯性，并适应这个会对你做出反应的世界。

物理与惯性: 遵循物理定律。即使松开按键，球体也会因惯性继续运动。

能量系统: 在起跳前决定高度。时机与精准度至关重要。

慢动作冲刺: 消耗能量进入慢动作模式。调整轨迹，在关键时刻脱险或跨越巨大的鸿沟。

可解锁的球类: 寻找并解锁隐藏在世界各地的篮球、沙滩球等。每种球的重量、弹力和推力各不相同。

互动环境: 抓取物品、解开谜题、激活压力按钮。但要小心，有些地板可能会塌陷。

敌人: 你的对手不只是重力。避开那些会吸取生命力的触手。

能量提升: 寻找增益道具以提升最大能量。你需要更强的力量来克服日益困难的关卡。

存档点: 它们能拉你一把，但前提是你得先到达那里。祝你好运。

summary:
Dungeoneer is a rouge-like, RPG, souls-like maybe future MMO game. Taking big inspiration from Dark Souls, Runescape, Hypixels Skyblock, Metin 2 and Enter The Gungeon.

Dungeon Depths

Dungeon Depths is a roguelike, souls-like RPG currently in development, with plans to expand into a full-scale online experience in the future.

It draws heavy inspiration from games like Enter The Gungeon, Hypixel Skyblock, Runescape, Metin2, and Dark Souls. The goal is to combine fast-paced, skill-based combat with deep progression systems and cooperative gameplay.

The Town / Hub

The town serves as the player’s main base. Here you can shop for items, accept quests, upgrade your gear, and prepare for the challenges ahead. It also holds the entrance to the dungeons, which form the core of the game.

The Dungeons

Each dungeon has its own theme and is divided into multiple floors. Every floor is randomly generated, ensuring that each run feels fresh and unpredictable. As you progress, enemies become tougher, and bosses await at the end of each floor. Once a floor is completed, players are graded on their performance from F to S+.

Gameplay

Dungeon Depths features a top-down view where players move using WASD and attack with the left and right mouse buttons. Each room spawns waves of enemies that must be defeated to unlock the doors and advance further.

Bosses include bullet hell-inspired mechanics, encouraging players to make use of the roll ability.

The game uses a classless system, allowing players to freely swap between different builds. Whether you prefer a defensive, tanky setup or a high-damage loadout, you can adjust your gear to fit your playstyle. With a wide variety of weapons, armors, and abilities, there’s plenty of room for creativity and experimentation.

Rebel Fury is a digital implementation of the wargame published by GMT Games and designed by Mark Herman.

Rebel Fury is a solo or two-person turn-based strategy wargame based on the Rebel Fury boardgame created by the legendary game designer Mark Herman and published by GMT Games. The game includes six historical battles: Fredericksburg, Chancellorsville, Chickamauga, Chattanooga, the Battle of the Wilderness and Spotsylvania. 

Players can battle human opponents online or play against the game's AI. There is a special solitaire-only scenario with a simplified AI for learning the game. 

Rebel Fury features gameplay based on the historical wargaming boardgames of the 70's and 80's. Players maneuver markers that represent their units on a hexagonal map that mimics the gameboard and cardboard counters of traditional boardgames. Turns are completed in an "I go, you go" style, wherein players alternate their turns with their opponent until one player passes. Once that happens, a random number of unopposed actions are given to their opponent. Pass too early and you risk giving your opponent the opportunity to maneuver completely around your forces. Combat is resolved through die rolls modified by terrain, battle line factors, and the use of artillery support. Attackers benefit from supporting units. Defenders benefit from being in defensible terrain. 

Rebel Fury is Volume 1 of The Civil War Heritage Series published by GMT Games. 

Each side has an historically accurate order of battle that encourages the player to attempt to outdo the generals of history. Each battle has a unique set of victory conditions that mirror the strategic goals of history. 

This design features a new system of Civil War combat akin to the old SPI Blue and Gray Quads. Each game in Rebel Fury is quick-set-up, quick-playing, and deeply interactive. The density of counters in each scenario is low, allowing you to see and experience the big picture of the battle.

summary:
This is a game set in space and focused on trade of resources between spaceships and space stations.

"STARS COMMANDER" is a game set in space and focused on trade

of material resources between spaceships and space stations.

Here are the main features of this game:

All the resources that can be managed are always valued at the same price

of reference, equal to the purchase and sale and specific for each resource.

In the game economy, profit is made on the transportation of resources

from one station to another and is a compensation linked to the quantity delivered,

so it doesn't matter looking for the best buyer or the best seller

but it is sufficient that there is a request, or availability,

of resources compatible with your spaceship.

Stations and spaceships can be purchased as additional possessions 

of the player's possessions.

Spaceships are not controlled with manual commands but are controlled, even remotely,

giving destination orders to the autopilot.

When the spaceship is docked at a station you can enter it

playing in first person.

In each station there is an access to the station computer to manage

resource exchange operations.

Additionally, some stations will give you the ability to dock "trailers."

Trailers are similar to spaceships but have no engine or crew

and can only be used for the transport of goods;

for their management a particular spaceship is used which carries out

the "tractor" function.

The aim of the game is to be able to increase your economic gain,

trying to buy stations and spaceships, and keeping active

station trade.

The difficulty of the game is due to poor resource production

in the stations because they were poorly supplied, or because they lacked crew,

this affects your financial situation due to costs

that you will have to bear.

As an option, to lower the difficulty of the game, in each station 

you have the possibility to find some cash prizes(in the fiction of the game)

hidden in some cupboards.
