《SIDE ALLEY》延续了姊妹作品《PSYCHOLOG》的独特风格，将沉浸式视觉小说的叙事魅力与第一人称点击互动玩法巧妙结合。

故事发生在一个压抑的都市环境中，这里天空鲜少可见，充满了“后室”风格的阴暗空间与令人不安的氛围。

随着诅咒逐渐加深，游戏独特的视觉风格也不断施加精神压力，使玩家仿佛被卷入一场比死亡更可怕的命运之中。

Common (50%)
Uncommon (24%)
Rare (12%)
Epic (7%)
Exotic (4%)
Mythical (2%)
Legendary (1%)
These probabilities determine how frequently you’ll obtain each rarity type. Common items are abundant, while legendary items are extremely rare and highly sought after.

Time-Based Item Drops:

Showcase Feature:
Players can use the items they collect to create words in their Steam profile showcase. This feature allows for a personalized touch, as players can arrange items to spell out their favorite words, messages, or names. The showcase adds a social and creative element to the game, making each item more valuable and meaningful.

In Cardaire you take the role of "Mulligan", an intrepid duelist who aims to make a name for herself in a world that revolves around a card game (how neat). Strategize on the Move

summary:
Evolutionary action at an intelligently designed pace! Tear through hordes of enemies, thrash colossal bosses, and collect new body parts to adapt your way through the increasingly deathly levels of this arcade survival adventure!

Evolution sims.
Seldom representing the concept of "adaptation" all too well, and often not particularly fun in the first place, games like Evo and Spore have always been the epitome of "mixed bag, missed potential." But what if we took a different approach? Instead of attempting to adapt Darwin and Gregor Mendel's notebooks into a multi-genre anthology game about evolving from slime mold to a race of gods, ErMa (Early Mammal) focuses on being a heck of a fun topdown action game powered by triple-distilled character customization.

What makes Erma different?

- A highly developed movement and procedural animation system. Much work has gone into balancing ease of control with making it fun and challenging to chase down prey and flee from predators.

- Over 100 interchangeable body parts, organs, and elemental gland weapons let you turn Erma into anything you see fit. Want to play a fire-breathing dragon that flies over the land and snatches up prey with its pincer tail? A giant sea monster that picks off foes from the river with its elongated neck and tongue? A tiny rodent that avoids predators while scooping up small lizards with its vacuum mouth? A menacing mole that ambushes from the walls, swallows enemies its own size whole, and covers its retreat with a cloud of paralyzing electric vapor? The possibilities are as impactful as they are numerous!

- An arcady gameplay loop keeps the action and adaptation going nonstop. Spawn into large, procedural maps, complete various objectives while staving off starvation, and move onto the next challenge!

- Bosses; like, some PROPER, multi-phase action game battles with unique gimmicks and movesets, not just a handful of bigger enemies.

summary:
An interactive, digital-media art project that uses historic streetcars as a metaphor to explore ideas about connection, communication, and community. The project is primarily intended for gallery / museum installations - this home-play edition is for personal, non-commercial use only.

Automata Streetcar is an interactive, digital-media art project that uses historic streetcars as a metaphor to explore ideas about connection, communication, and community. The project is inspired by the four historic streetcar systems that once operated in British Columba - in Victoria, Vancouver, North Vancouver, and in particular the small, remote mountain community of Nelson. 

As mechanical devices, streetcars may be interpreted as a type of automata: self-guided, interactive mechanisms that respond to a sequence of predetermined instructions. They follow a fixed track through city streets, stopping to collect passengers at predetermined locations, operating within a sequential yet highly interactive environment.

The project is primarily intended for installation in a museum or gallery setting, featuring a composition of large-scale physical objects with digital projections onto adjacent walls or screens.  Interacting with the physical art objects (as custom-made game controllers) allows exhibit visitors to explore a digital recreation of Nelson's main street as it was 100 years ago when streetcars operated there. Players take on the roles of the conductor and driver to operate a streetcar, collect passengers, and build community confidence. A version of the project can also be downloaded to experience at home using a standard keyboard and mouse arrangement.

Home Play Version

This Early-Access edition of Automata Streetcar is a simplified version of the art project that presents the interactive, digital-media components in a format for personal, non-commercial home-use.  It is not intended for public exhibition or display, or to generate images for public or commercial purpos

Controls

WASD / Arrow Keys – Move

Space – Jump

Z – Interact

Gameplay

Your goal is simple: reach the green arrow to ascend to the next level. But in Level Down, every move matters. One wrong step could send you plummeting—One wrong step could send you plummeting—not just one floor, but multiple levels down, undoing your progress in an instant. As you climb higher, the challenge ramps up with new mechanics, unpredictable tiles, and heart-pounding obstacles.

Each level is a fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled obstacle course that pushes your reflexes and decision-making to the limit.. Will you take the risky path for a faster climb, or play it safe and steady? With so many unique levels, the game keeps you on your toes with increasingly complex challenges.

Key Features

100 Hand-selected Procedurally Generated Levels: Each level is uniquely designed to test your skills, with no two floors feeling the same.

Diverse Tile Mechanics: Tiles behave in wild and unpredictable ways—some crumble, some slide, and some even bounce you in unexpected directions.

Checkpoint Levels: Every 5 floors, take a breather at checkpoint levels. Interact with NPCs for hints, lore, or just a quick break.

A malevolent and relentless presence dwells within these walls, and she has no intention of letting you leave alive.

战斗等级

在新的战场上战斗，地点和物体不断变化，让您每次都有机会制定不同的策略。

事件级别

发现事件级别，您将根据您的行为和所选选项获得奖励或惩罚。

在击败一波又一波的敌人后，还有一场极具挑战性的 Boss 战在等着你。每个 Boss 都有自己独特的机制可供探索。发现它们并利用它们的弱点来取得胜利。

在与不同类型的敌人战斗时，选择适合你风格的武器来制定最有效的策略。你需要仔细规划每一步，才能在艰苦的战斗中运用最佳战术生存下来。

您的进度取决于您如何管理资源。杀死您遇到的敌人并收集他们的掉落物。

Rogue Like 模式

购买或升级卡牌和武器，或者通过从随着您晋级而随机出现的商店购买补给品来继续生存。

挖掘地图上的坟墓并收集里面的奖励。引爆周围的桶，让你更容易杀死敌人。通过使用更多物体，探索杀死敌人的不同方法。

summary:
独自或与好友一起，潜入无情的深海噩梦！在Gornak恐怖的深渊中为工会完成致命任务。修复破裂管道，替换故障设备，收集前人散落的残骸来偿还债务……前提是当地生物没有先找到你。

畏惧深海吧。无论你害怕深海、密闭空间，还是单纯恐惧未知，Gornak的黑暗海域都会把你拖进一场无情的水下噩梦。

潜入深渊，修复逐渐腐烂的水下基础设施。你有刑期要服，有债务要还。为工会冒死执行危险任务：修复破裂的管道，替换严重故障的设备，甚至回收那些失败者散落的残骸。

黑暗中，你并不孤单。你终将遇到当地的生物……而它们饿了。向Stiska祈祷自己能活下去，然后躲进你唯一的安全之处：一艘宏伟而先进的Gornak潜艇！

和好友组成船员一同下潜，并祈祷当一切不可避免地失控时，你不是最后一个溺亡的人。更想独自下潜？Gornak冶金工会会提供最低限度的支援，尽量避免你惨死。毕竟，他们非常关心你……或者更准确地说，他们关心的是别让一艘昂贵潜艇惨遭损失。

summary:
Dungeons & Desserts is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you also manage a pastry shop. Journey through candy-themed realms, gather rare ingredients and craft mouth-watering desserts to sell in your cosy bakery, all while balancing the pressures of a greedy landlord constantly increasing your rent.

Dungeons & Desserts is a cozy dungeon crawler meets bakery sim. Crawl candy-themed dungeons for ingredients, craft desserts to sell, and try not to miss rent, or your landlord takes your furniture.

Running a bakery isn’t easy, especially with a greedy, micromanaging landlord breathing down your neck. Every week, they make up new fees and increase the rent, forcing Crispin to work harder just to keep his business afloat. Don’t miss too many payments, or you could lose everything.

Features

 Explore the candy-themed dungeons, fight candy foes, and collect exotic ingredients for your bakery.

Craft mouthwatering desserts, stock your displays, and serve customers to keep your shop running.

Upgrade your kitchen, attract more customers, and boost productivity to stay ahead of the ever-increasing rent.

Race Against Time – With limited daily actions, you must balance exploration, baking, and shopkeeping before the next rent deadline.

summary:
Enter "Sooty's Rest," the forbidden forest where the legendary fire prevention mascot, Sooty The Bear, is real. Use your compass, flashlight, and survival skills to escape his pursuit. Navigate, hide, and outsmart Sooty in this thrilling wilderness survival horror game. Can you make it out alive?

If you go out in the woods today, you're in for a big surprise.

Your years of experience hiking and camping have led you to this moment: the forbidden part of the forest known only as "Sooty's Rest".
Never Meet Your Heroes

Everyone knows the story of Sooty The Bear, the lovable fire prevention mascot whose face and slogan have been seen on countless posters, commercials, and billboards for over 70 years. What they don't know is that Sooty is real, and you've just entered his territory. Once you set up camp and start your campfire, Sooty knows you're there.
Survive and Escape

Navigate the Wilderness: Use your skills with a compass and flashlight to find your way to safety before Sooty finds you.

Distract and Evade: Start campfires to distract Sooty and keep him off your trail.

Plan Your Escape: Use park maps to plot your route out of the park.

Hide and Seek: Hide in bear lockers, bathrooms, and ranger stations to stay safe during the night.

Stay on Track: Try not to get lost.

Sooty's Rest is a thrilling horror indie game that combines elements of psychological horror and survival horror in a wilderness setting. With a chilling atmosphere and relentless pursuit by Sooty, you'll need all your wits and courage to make it out alive.

Will you make it out, or will Sooty find you first?

summary:
East DefenseYour duty is to protect the castle by strategically building & upgrading towers to stop monsters from coming their way!

East Defense

Is a tower defense game that focuses on achieving a good balance between entertainment and challenge, being suitable for both hardcore and casual players who would love to either explore tower defense games style or challenge themselves against various waves of monsters by strategically placing and upgrading multiple towers to prevent the monsters from reaching the castle along the path!

Core game mechanics

Monsters will try to reach the castle, and you have to build and upgrade towers to prevent them from doing so.

There are various types of monsters, which you can learn more about as you encounter them in the game.

Each tower has a special skill to boost its power, which can be unlocked by upgrading the tower.

Winning each level without allowing any monster to reach the castle grants you 3/3 stars, which can be later used to unlock special levels with unique gameplay mechanics!

Towers

There are 10 tower types to use in the game.

Unlock towers' maximum potential by placing them in the optimum spot to make the most use of their power.

Each tower can be upgraded five times and has its own special skill unlocked.

Using a variety of towers is the key to defeating all types of monster waves. 

Monsters

Monsters aim to reach the castle in waves, each with its own speed and health.

Killing monsters grants you gold, which can be used to build and upgrade towers.

Each monster can have multiple traits to make it stronger and more dangerous.

On the 10th wave and every 5 waves, bosses will appear! And they are harder to defeat and will cause high damage to the castle if they pass through your defenses!

Don't wait anymore! Explore the wonderful world of East Defense and be the one to repeal all monster waves!

summary:
A top-down 2D space game about going fast through platformer-style levels. Master your ship's momentum-based movement, unlock abilities, race the clock and hunt for secrets as you guide lost astronaut Riley on her journey home from deep space.

When a routine job gets knocked suddenly off course, young astronaut Riley is left stranded deep in space and needs to find her way back home.

With three of the warp relays - which allow humanity to travel light-years in the blink of an eye - taken offline, her only option is to complete the challenging trials needed to reboot the relays.

Gameplay features

Rocket through more than 20 handcrafted top-down levels, mastering your ship's momentum-based movement to evade hazards, complete objectives, and restore power to the relays.

Upgrade your ship and restore its lost abilities, allowing you to overcome new obstacles.

Race the clock and try to beat each level's target time by perfecting your route and pushing your speed to the limit.

Discover secret items hidden within every level, unlocking new skins for your ship and giving extra glimpses into Riley's life back home.

summary:
Sandbox Apocalypse is a 3rd person view, open world post-apocalyptic survial game where you are responsible for your own fate. Survive in a world inhabited by zombies, gather loot, build your base and explore the world. 

This is a game developed by me (Ben). The game is currently under development and available in an early access version in order to gather feedback from the community. You can clearly see which other indie and non-indie games have been an inspiration to me. My aim is to combine the survival aspect and life simulation with an extensive crafting system.

There is already a lot you can do whilst playing the game: 

Explore the 2 by 1 kilometer (2 square kilometer map - roughly 0.8 square miles)

Go on an adventure by your own (single player) or with up to 3 friends (multiplayer)

Fight the zombies with a bunch of different weapons (and other items)

Search and find loot that will help you to survive (clothes, weapons, food, medical items) 

Salvage whatever you can within the game and build a house for yourself

Experience day and night, change the environment, do some landscaping or dig trenches

Claim a vehicle and drive around 

There are many things you currently cannot do or play with, but they are high on the list of priorities. I plan to add the following features: 

Weather simulation (rain, fog etc.)

A map that will eventually comprise 10 x 10 kilometers 

 More vehicles, weapons, loot

Modding

summary:
Shadow of The Forerunner is a card-based roguelike game with RPG elements set in a dark cyberpunk world. The game features a unique system of aspects and flaws, diverse equipment options, and prosthetics that influence the composition of your deck.

World
Once, mystical power that entered through rifts from another dimension granted incredible strength to chosen individuals. However, everything changed when energy beings emerged from these rifts and began taking over the bodies of power users. The world plunged into chaos. Now, the remnants of humanity live in constant fear, and using this power always carries the risk of becoming a puppet of these sinister entities.
System of Aspects and Flaws
Each new run will start with different aspects and flaws that balance each other. Aspects provide various positive bonuses and abilities, while flaws add negative modifiers to maintain balance. The stronger the aspects you receive, the more significant and unpleasant the flaw will be. Some enemies will have random aspects and flaws that the player will need to adapt to.
Equipment
During your runs, you will find various equipment cards. Equipping these cards will add new cards to your deck and provide various bonuses. The equipment system allows for the creation of numerous deck combinations, and the right synergy with aspects can lead to spectacular results.
Prosthetics
Prosthetic cards provide various abilities in battles, but their use consumes both action points and limited energy points. Equipping prosthetics is only possible at certain locations, as is the restoration of energy needed for their use.
The Power that Ruined the World
The local "magic" available to your character grants mystical power in battles. This power allows you to perform actions that can drastically change the course of a fight. However, its use is limited by the number of magic points required, which are difficult to replenish.

Dark Ascent is a challenging 2D platformer that tests your skill, patience, and strategy as you strive to reach the summit of an exceedingly tall world. With low visibility and no checkpoints to save your progress, every jump and dash must be executed with precision and foresight. The game's core mechanics revolve around managing and enhancing your abilities to overcome the increasingly difficult climb.

Core Mechanics:

“一切都准备好了。”

现在，拿起你自己的双手，拯救被机器人占领的地下世界吧。

挑战自己，创造新纪录。

Feature

- H-Shifter 已在游戏中。

- 使用离合器踏板换档。使用制动踏板和油门踏板加速和停止。

- 离合器非常重要。

- “训练区”在演示版中不可用。

- 在试玩版中，当您按下开始游戏时，您将立即进入“挑战区”。

- 在演示版本中，您最多只能杀死 10 名敌人。

- 在演示版本中，没有可以查看游戏历史记录的大厅。

- 在演示版本中，档位控制部分覆盖了简单的操作方法。

"Challenge Zone"

- 每次开始新游戏时，地图和敌人位置都会发生变化。

- 您可以随时保存并退出游戏并稍后继续玩。

- 有加油站、修理店、武器店和物品店。

- 在“挑战区”中，杀死 50 名敌人所需的时间会被记录并排名。尝试缩短您的历史记录。

- 你可以使用特殊武器来实施差异化的策略。

"Training Zone"

- 您可以一边观看友好的讲解一边练习。

- “训练区”提供无限的物品、护甲和燃料。

- “训练区”不记录时间，因此您可以舒适地练习。练习直到你完全适应为止。

Game Tip

要使用商店电梯，请解除所有武器和特殊能力并关闭引擎。
